tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (155)pha bka' drin mtshungs med chos kyi rje/mgon bstan pa'i nyi mar phyag byas nas/pha yul du 'gro ba'i kha chems yin/bu gzhi la sdong pa'i pha phog yin/do
(155)pha bka' drin mtshungs med chos kyi rje/mgon bstan pa'i nyi mar phyag byas nas/pha yul du 'gro ba'i kha chems yin/bu gzhi la sdong pa'i pha phog yin/do

tei:div.tei:p: (155)pha bka' drin mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ mgon bstan pa'i nyi mar phyag byas nas/ pha yul du 'gro ba'i kha chems yin/ bu gzhi la sdong pa'i pha phog yin/ don sems la bcang na gdams ngag yin/ bu a this ba this la bshad pa/ deng song snyigs ma'idus 'di na sems can mi srun pa'i rang bzhin las/ yang dag pa'i lam dang mthun pa rnyed dka' bas mja' bshes dang 'brel 'dre+is su la yang snyig gtam ma 'chad/ kha mang bya byed mang pos rang gzhan phung la sbyor bas/ dus rtag tu bzang ngan 'bring gsum gang gi skyon dang yon tan mthong yang bstod smad tshig gcig tsam gzhan la ma shor/ rang gi sems la dran pa'i gtam de wa zhe gnyis mid kyi drang skad bshad pa med pas bzang ngan gnyis kar mi 'gro ba'i gtam lung ma bstan las rang gi zhe phug nas dran pa'i gtam de nam yang ma bshad/ kham pa nang brdzu'i sha tsha'i gros 'debs 'dra mos bslu bas de la yid ma gtod/ rtag 'jin tshe 'di'i zhon pa chos kyi bar chad du che bas tshong dang bun skyed khyim pa'i tshe 'jin la ma rem/ lus ngag gi (156)bya ba bag med pa 'di nyes pa thams cad kyi snod dang 'byung gnas yin pas/ lus ngag spyod pa zhi dul dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ snyigs ma'i dbyis pa'i grogs kyis bslu bas bla ma mtshan nyid nga ldan pa dang dge ba'i grogs po khyad par can dang 'grogs/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten gzhi yin pas/ pham lhag bcu bdun po srog bsdos la btags nas ci nas ma gos pa zhig dgos/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chos kyi rten lags pas ting nge 'jin bzang po re dgos/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra thams cad 'joms pa la med thabs med pa'i thos bsam yang dag pa zhig dgos/ de thams cad kyi rten 'byung du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ de mnyis pa gsum gyi thugs zin pa zhig dgos/ des gdams pa'i chos la skom pas chu btung ba lta bu zhig dgos/

btung ba tsam gyis mi chog par yon tan gyis rgyud gang ba zhig dgos/ mdor na gnyen po rang tshugs thub pa rig rig long ba lta bu/ thos thos la 'on pa lta bu+u/ gzhan la bstod smad gnyis ka mi byed pa/ nyon mongs thams cad la sran gzugs nus pa/ tshe 'dir (157)blo mi gtod pa rang mthong dang nga rgyal med pa blo chos la bkol ba 'bad 'bung chos la 'don pa zhig dgos/ de ma yin pa ra go thos mthong rgya che ba/ nga rgyal dang pho zob mtho ba/ rang gi rgyud kyi skyon la mi rtog zhing mi mthong la/ gzhan skyon kho na la rtog pa/ bya byed dang zer brjod mang ba/ chos la rgyab kyis phyogs zhing tshe 'di gtso bor sems shing skyo shas dang nges byung med pa'i skya ser gnyis go chod pa'i ban ma hor zhig tu song nas/ phyi ma rlung la bskur ba'i ston pa thugs rje can gyis bstan pa'i bla btsong du 'gro la de gnyis gang byed da lta khyod rang gi lag na gdam ka yod pas/ dus nam yang sems la mjub mo tshug la rang gi rgyud la rtog dpyod nam yang rgyag dgos pa 'di gdam pa'i mthar thug pa yin pas nam yang dran dgos dran dgos/ nang nas nyon mongs dgra ru mi mthong na/ phyi nas bla ma'i gdams ngag rdug pa gda' gsungs pa 'di/ nang ma re re bzhin ma brjed/ ha ha/ lo lnga'i bar gyis mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs de tsam gdams par shar nas rgyud chos dang mthun pa nga'i bla btsong du mi 'gro ba zhig nges par dgos pa (158)lags so/ ༄༅/ na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra ya/ rnam 'dren stong gis gdul thabs bral ba/ snyigs ma'i skye bo thugs rjes bzung zhing*/ dpal chen pad+ma dkar po ltar bsngags/ shākya'i tog min su zhig gzhan tshol/ dang po thugs bskyed dam bca' ma nyams/ bar du rlabs chen brtson pa mi 'dor/ zag med bdud rtsi'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i/ seng ge'i sgra chen gtam gyi 'khor lo/ rtsibs rnon mu khyud 'jin gyi skabs gsum/

mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i skal bar sbyin pa/ thub pa'i dbang po chos kyi rgyal pos/ dang po 'dul ba'i bka' khrims bcas la/ skyed dgu'i gtso bo 'da' bar mi spobs/ 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis khrims su bzhes bzhes/ 'jam gling 'di na rin chen gsum zhes/ grags pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtser bsgreng song*/ bar du mdo sde zab dang rgya che'i/ ting 'jin sgo brgya 'byed dang chab gcig gzungs sprin spob pa'i yon tan gtam pa'i/ 'phags pa'i skye bos gling 'dir mjes byas/ tha ma khyod kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ nges don lam gyi zab gnas phra mo/ gab sbas med par ljen par brtsal (159)bas/ de nyid gzigs pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa/ 'dus pa'i grangs la tshad bzung ma shes/ khyod kyi gsung gi gsang ba zab mo/ rtags kyi smi mtshon bshad pas mi god/ bstan pas ci cha bla yi yul min/ spros las 'das pa brjod pa'i lam min/ rnam pa kun ldan theg pa'i rim pa/ drang nges ldem dgongs sna tshogs 'byed la/ rgyal bas bsngags pa 'phags pa'i gzigs pa/ rnam par dag pa'i shing rta rnam gnyis/ ci ltar bkral ba'i zab rgyas lam 'di/ 'jam gling mkhas pas bdag gir bzhes nas/ klu thog dgongs pa 'di tsam 'du zhes/ legs bshad gsar pa'i dga' ston spros song*/ da lta'i dus 'dir rtsod pa'i skye bo/ 'dod lha'i bdud 'di snying la bab cing*/ lce la gdon de'i byin brlabs zhugs pas/ 'gal 'du'i rigs pa ltar snang mang pos/ rang gzhan rgyu brlag las ngan bsags pas/ rgya bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad len dus/ gzu bo don gnyer shes rab ldan zhing*/ bden gnyis dpyod pa'i blo gros med na/ rang dga'i blun pos shes tshod ma red/ dus ngan skye bo chags sdang rtsod rtsod/ rang (160)phyogs sgrub la rtags chos mod kyang*/ gzhan phyogs dgag pa'i thal 'gyur dug mda'/ phyogs lnga med la gang dgar 'phen pa/ 'dod lha'i mda' yi do zlar mi 'os/ thos don bden gnyis dpyod pa'i bsam pas/

blang dor gnas la sgrin por dgos na/ spom yor thos pas rlom sems che nas/ blo sna mi khug mtho snang tshe 'ong*/ mang du thos pa yon tan gzhi ma/ tshul khrims ldan pa lha mi'i mchod gnas/ ting 'jin shes rab rgyud la sbyor na/ so skye lags kyang thub pa'i rjes 'jug las ngan bdag gi bla ma byed tshe/ thos med skye bo gdol spyod ngan pa/ dbyug pas bkag kyang mi khog 'ching 'ong*/ mos gus med pa'i thal tshub ma slong*/ chos la 'dus pa'i tha snyad bzung kyang*/ chos brgyad gnyer ba'i zhe phug bzhag nas/ bla ma mgo skor su bas thu ba/ slob ma 'dus kyang dga' rgyu mi 'dug yun thung skor rgyug zla ngos tsam la/ zab mo gdams pa dgos rgu dgos zhes/ rgyu mtshan med pa'i hor gtam sgrogs la/ blun po'i mi rnams thu tshab che 'ong*/ yun ring 'dug pa'i mthun rkyen 'jom dus/ 'brel 'dris che bas gzer (161)mchu mang ba/ phan tshun rtsod pa'i ru ma 'jog 'ong*/ bstan sel sde 'khrugs slong ba'i ltas ngan/ gshis gyong go med bshad pas ma phan/ bstan pas mi rtogs chos med dred po/ rang yul log dus sngar bzhin khyad med/ rgyu 'bras gnas 'di ston pa gang gi gsung gi gsang ba zab mo yin snyams/ zhib cha bgyis te bshad kyang mi tshim/ mthon po'i tshig la rlom sems cher song*/ mchog dman 'gro ba las 'bras mi mgu chos la phag g.yas nor la 'jab gyin/ phyi tshul bcos pa'i btsun tshug bzang po/ rnam 'dren staun pa'i rjes 'jug ma red/ rgya bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad gnas la/ thos pa gyis zhes bskul bar byed kyang*/ zhe kha ma bab ngo ru gnag 'dug mos pa med pas yid kha ma phyes/ gzhan yang cung zad sbyang bar rloms nas/ rtsa ba sa bcad sbrel shes tsam re/ byung dus chos la chog shes byed nas/ slob gnyer bskyur nas che 'dir chas 'gro tshogs lam 'di bzung rgyun mtha'i bar du/ thos pa'i tha ma rjogs rgyu mi 'dug mkhyen gnyis mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas 'dod na/

rgyu mchog thos las gzhan (162)zhig mi shes/ mnyam med thub dbang 'gro ba'i mgon pos/ thos pa bsags pas go 'phang brnyes zhing*/ chos mjod ston pa ci ltar yin zhes/ skyes rab rnam thar gzhung la dris shig cung zad tshig la go ba chags dus/ brtson pa ma 'dor rang rgyun bsring ste/ mkhas pa'i gzhung la lta rtogs gyis dang*/ rang sa'i ba legs par chags 'ong*/ 'gal 'du bsgrigs pa'i bsam ngan spong la/ drang po'i lam nas dpyod pa rgyob dang*/ thams cad mi 'gal dgongs pa mthun 'ong*/ bsams zhing rgyud la sbyor ba med na/ go skam tshig gis sems rgyud mi 'dul/ rang gshis gyong po nor la rtsis che/ mkhos med zhen log chos la bsgom 'dug lo 'dod grags pa zhe na gnas pa/ kha tas ma chun chos kyi mi 'dul/ brid pas ma khug bsdig pas mi non/ 'dre rgod lang la bya thabs ci yod/ la las cung zad yar la bltas nas/ snyan rgyud bsgom pa'i man ngag bsnyags nas/ sngon 'gro nas bzung mthar thug lam bar/ bshad pa byas kyang blo ldog rnam bzhi/ phyag len yin snyams rtsis med bor nas/ sgom pa 'dod kyang chos gzhugs shor ba/ sna (163)log sgom chen mar la rgyug 'gro snyan brgyud man ngag bshad pas ci 'gyur/ 'dir snang spros pa'i zhen pa che bas/ ngos lkog spyod pas ma rab spyod pa/ chos dang mi mthun gang yang byed pa/ dmu rgod rnams la zab mo'i gdams pa/ ma bshad bskyur thang chos rtsis mi 'dug khams pa nang brdzus snying gtam gling na/ yid la bcag pa'i phug nor de byed/ gong ma'i snyan brgyud chu la phyag nas/ ltar snang bcos ma'i lus tshug 'jin 'dug bslu med skyabs gnas rin chen gsum la/ yid ches nges pa'i skyabs 'gro mi byed/ mthu chen 'dod pas gdug 'dre sgrub zhing*/ dgra la 'chi ba'i yid smamon sgoms pas/ re 'khang yi chad lha la gsol nas/ ngas byas sgrub yus bla mar 'pho ba/ re dogs sems la skyur dus med pa'i/

sgrub pa de 'dra mu stegs los yin/ byang chub sems mchog chos kyi gzhi ma/ sangs rgyas sgrub na med thabs med de/ bsgom pa dgos zhes bla ma'i ma gsungs/ slob mas ma go rang 'dod bsgrub na/ bka' bkyon drag po'i char pa phab kyang*/ khong skran rdo skom nem dus mi 'byung*/ man (164)ngag thang so sems kyi tha bar/ btsugs nas nyams len rgyud la sbyor dgos/ gnad med stong 'dug mi tshe zad na/ ri la bsdad pa don 'bras chung bas/ byang chub sems 'di ma bcos pa zhig ma skyes bar du sngags la ma 'jug 'di med lam gyi gzugs brnyan thams cad/ phyi nang kun la thun mong yod na/ bskyed rdzogs bsgom kyang sangs rgyas mi 'khrug rgya 'dre 'gong po de la nye 'ong*/ mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma sangs rgyas/ brten thabs mi shes gra pa'i zhe sa/ khyed lags sbyar ba g.yo sgyu'i gcam tshig mi bden ngo ma rang mgo ma skor/ yon tan gang yang mthong thos med nas/ gzhan zer rgyug pa'i gsol 'debs bcos ma/ bla ma sgom zer kha pho smra rung*/ mu stegs lam las gzhan du mi 'khyongs/ byed pa rgyu mthun nam yang mi bslu/ g.yo sgyu mkhan slob mgo bo bskor kyang*/ dbyings na bzhugs pa'i sras bcas rgyal ba/ zag med gzigs pa sgrib med sus bslu/ da lta'i bya ba ngos lkog byed dus/ g.yo sgyu'i gos bzang sgrib byed bzang kyang*/ gshin rje'i khrims la g.yo sgyu mi tshud/ kha zhe med par bla ma brten dgos/ (165)sems gnas 'jur bu'i a tshug byed pa/ sgom chen bzang po gling gzhi byed kyang*/ zhi gnas glen sgom 'khor ba'i sa bon/ phyi pa'i lam las nang pa yin nam/ thos pa med par sgom pa mi shes/ thos don bsgom pas skyong ba yin na/ kha bshad mkhan zhes lung rtogs gnyis la/ than du rtsi pa'i sgom chen sgam po/ snying rus che rung 'khrul snang zang ma/ kha bshad mang rung lag len ma khel/ bun rdo 'phen la rgyal ba mi dgyes/

'khrul ba'i lam ngan smyo ba min nam/ zhi gnas rkyang pas nyon mongs ma non/ sgom chen 'dod pa'i zhags pas bcing zhing*/ mi byed dgu byed gcig la shor dus/ grub thob zer kyang grub thob ma red/ 'khor 'das skyon yon sems kyis byed kyang*/ gtsod de yin zhes gsar sgros bzau ma/ blun pos snyan rgyud rlom pa byed kyang*/ sems tsam gtso bo su yi los shos/ skye gnas 'gags pa'i rigs pa phra mo'i/ gtan tshig gar 'gro cha med bor nas/ ci zer gzan la dri ba'i 'bar rgyug med ces zer la dkar rgyu ma red/ sems rig shan 'byed kha la btags kyang*/ (166)gzungs 'jin sems la ngo sprod 'debs pa'i/ bcos ma'i snyan rgyud da dus dar bas/ skal bzang skye bo'i yid khar ma bab/ 'dod lha'i bdud 'di byin rlabs che bas/ lan ngan ji snyed pa stong khyab nas/ mkhas pa'i gzhung bzang ro bzhin bor btang*/ byed thabs bral ba snying rje'i gnas yin/ nyams snang za bre'i mtho snang shar nas/ tshig bcad thor bu sdebs byor med pa/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs mjod yin zhes/ byi pho tshol ba'i thabs bzang rnyed 'dug ngur smrig 'jin pa'i rgyal mtshan bor nas/ khyim pa'i cha lugs dang du lon pa'i/ smyo spyod mkhan 'di su yi chos lugs/ log pa'i lam la zad mtha' ci yod/ sngags spyod ngan pas dmigs rkyon byed nas/ skya ser gnyis min ban ma hor 'dras/ deng song rgyal khams kheb la nye dus/ gos dkar lcang lo sngags lugs ma yin/ gu ru bzhugs dus gos dkar ljang lo/ khrims ldan khyim pa dam tshig ldan pa/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis la rang dbang 'byor zhing*/ grub pa mngon gyur sha stag lags na/ da dus spyod ngan sngags la g.yar ba'i/ dam tshig mi ldan (167)bskyed rjogs phar zhog rgyud lung man ngag mtshan tsam ma thos/ rang dgar pho rgod sngags pa ma yin/ dbang phyug lhar 'jin phyi pa'i rang lugs/ ral pa khur bu spyod lam rang ga bud med bston la thar lam re ba'i/

rmong pa'i skye bo rang gzhan mgo skor/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub la nye bas/ gna' dus bzang po'i khrims lugs mi 'jin/ gsar pa kha bsags gya gyu'i sems can/ kla klo bas kyang 'di nyid thu'o/ stong skad kha pho dpa' snying che rung*/ mi 'dod rkyen ngan thog tu 'bebs tshe/ sems la re dogs 'jur bu'i bcing pa/ don med lta ba'i mtho skad ma rgyag mngon sum rtogs pa'i lta ba yod na/ 'phags pa'i lam rtags mi mngon mi srid/ nyams len drod rtags gang yang med na/ mig ru gzeng kyang phan pa mi 'dug blun sgom sems btsir kha pho ma che/ mkhas pa'i gzhung la gom 'dris byed dgos/ lam dang lam min shan 'byed tsam zhig dang po med na sems 'jin gtad po/ gar 'gro shes sam a bu bu lo/ sangs rgyas stong gi thugs kyi dgongs (168)don/ mdo sngags lam gnad ma tshang med pa/ kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i legs bshad bor nas/ yang dag lam zhig gzhan nas mi rnyed/ de las gzhan pa'i snyan rgyud zer ba/ log pa'i lam la the tshom mi dgos/ rang dgas sbyar bas 'khrul pa med na/ 'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid ci 'dra dpyod dgos/ da ni gang la bcos mar go nas/ rdzun gter zog po yid la ma bab/ blun po'i snyan rgyud chu la skyur thong*/ bcos ma'i lta ba len snying ma 'dod/ lo 'dod re ltos 'grub dus mi 'dug re dwogs zhen pa'i sems las mi dgos/ snang ba sgyu ma g.yo thabs mkhas pas/ col chung sems la bya ra los dgos/ snyigs ma'i mngon rtogs mthu dpung che bas/ gnyen po'i rjogs chen gtan 'joms byed cis/ snying stobs brtson pa'i go chen bgos nas/ gnad 'bebs rig pa'i mda' rnon 'phen ran/ lam gyi mtha' rgya thos pas chod dgos/ zab mo'i gsang lam bsam pas myong dgos/ de nyid dgongs pa bsgom pas rtogs dgos/ de dag med pa pho tshod rkyang pa/ mdo rgyud gzhung lam rig pas mjal dus/ phyogs zhen (169)spang ba'i ma 'khyogs drang po/

mkho gal che rung su la med tshod/ zhen lta'i kha khyer rlung po stong 'ur/ dus ngan zer zhing sems can gzings kyang*/ dus ngan ma red spyod ngan shom yin/ bstan pa'i gzhi la so sor thar pa/ gar song 'gro mtshams rtogs dpyod mi rgyag byang chub sems mchog sangs rgyas sa bon/ rtsis med re bzhin rgyab tu bskur btang*/ spros bral mthon po'i kha skad nyan nas/ mdo sngags gzhung lam chu la phyag tshar/ mdung tshugs gtad po'i sems 'jin tsam las/ zang thal rig pa'i mtho sgros btags pa/ sa lam yon tan ming tsam yin zer/ log pa'i lam la rgyug mkhan mang bas/ bshad pas ci byed kha bshad rkyang pa/ rang gzhan grub mtha'i chags sdang rtsod pa'i/ chos spang las ngan rgyud la bsags nas/ bshad pa mi 'dod rgyang gi bor btang*/ bsam pa mi 'dod bsam tshad tshe 'di/ chos brgyad rtog pa'i dug ro lhang dus/ man ngag bdud rtsi bcud du ma lon/ gnyan por ma song bsam pas ci bya/ bsgom snying yid la gtan nas ma 'dod/ don spyi (170)'khrul par blo gtad sus byed/ bsgom chen rnams la lam rtags gang yang*/ med pa 'di nyid 'khrul pa los yin/ thos bsam sgom pa'i gtam las drang ba/ rtog ge nges pa'i rtogs brjod zang ma/ dben pa'i yang khrod ljon pa lung nas/ snying gi bu la spreng ba yin na/ ma brjed rtag tu rgyud la sbyor dgos/ bshad bshad nyan los mi tshe ba dan/ 'chi kha chos med lag stong 'gro ba/ mthong thos los yod lo rgyus mi dgos/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang dpal bzang du 'bod pas bu a this pa this la spreng ba dge'o/// /
